items.question: In what year did the United Arab Emirates become a member of the World Trade Organization (WTO)?
items.fact: UAE has been a WTO member since 1996.

items.question: Does the UAE allow full foreign ownership of commercial companies on the mainland for business setup?
items.gold: Yes, the page lists full foreign ownership of commercial companies on the mainland as a feature of the UAE's favourable economic environment.
items.fact: UAE permits full foreign ownership of mainland commercial companies.
